svg.aria-label: Who it is for: three small front pages side by side, each in its own colours. A light moves from one to the next: on Anzu, a book loses its lock and becomes an EPUB file; on Sharur, a long reply shrinks to a short one; on Svipall, a page gets through a wall to an AI agent. Under each, the kind of project: a book app, a writing style for AI, a web tool for AI.
